m: अव-√ भा -√ भाति, to shine downwards, RV. i, 154, 6 (v.l. -भारि, fr. अव-√ भृ, VS. vi, 3); to shine, be brilliant, Hariv. 13100; to appear, become manifest, MBh. iii, 10094; BhP.; Rājat.

अव-√ भास् -भासते, to shine forth, be brilliant, MBh.; BhP.; to become manifest, appear as (instr.) : Caus. P. (p. -भासयत्, wrongly written -भाषयत्, MBh. xii, 8345) to illuminate, MBh. &c.; to make manifest, Suśr.
a: अवभास् — {c1c} A. 1 To shine; नात्यर्थमस्त्रैरवभासमानः Ki. 3. 46; स तेजसा सूर्य इवावभासते Mb. --2 To shine forth, become manifest; आहोस्विन्मुखमवभासते युवत्याः Śi. 8. 29. --3 To appear, seem (apparently or falsely); एतत्त्रयं तप्तायःपिंडवदेकत्वेनावभासते Vedānta. --Caus. To irradiate, illuminate; अधिकावभासितदिशां निकरः Śi. 9. 37.

v: pu॰ ava + BAsa--BAve GaY । 1 jYAne 2 prakASe anyasya anyarUpeRa prakASarUpe 3 miTyAjYAne ca ।
m: अव-भास m. splendour, lustre, light
appearance (especially ifc. with words expressing a colour), Jain.; Suśr.
(in Vedānta phil.) manifestation
reach, compass, see, श्रवणावभ्˚.
a: अवभासः — 1 Splendour, lustre, light. --2 Knowledge, perception. --3 Appearance, manifestation, in spiration; येनास्य तत्त्वेषु कृतेऽवभासे Ki. 3. 26. --4 Space, reach, compass. --5 False knowledge. --Comp. --करः N. of a divinity. --प्रभाः (pl.) N. of a whole class of deities.

v: tri॰ avamAsayati ava + BAsa--Ric Rvul । 1 prakASake sarvvAvaBAsakekUwasTe cEtanye na॰ । “yasya BAsA sarvvamidaM viBAti” SruteH “yadAdityagataM tejo jagatBAsaya te'Kilam । yaccandramasi yaccAgrO tattejo vidDi mAmakam” gItokteSca tasya sarvvAvaBAsakatvam ।
m: अव-भासक mfn. (in Vedānta phil.) illuminating, making manifest.
a: अवभासक — a. Luminous, irradiating. --कं The Supreme spirit; ˚त्वं luminousness.

m: अव-भास—कर m. N. of a Devaputra, Lalit.
अव-भासन n. shining, Bhpr.
becoming manifest, Sāh.
(in Ved. phil.) illuminating.
अव-भासन—शिखिन् m. N. of a Nāga demon, Buddh.
अव-भास—प्राप्त m. N. of a world, Buddh.
अव-भास—प्रभ m. pl. N. of a class of deities, Buddh.
अव-भासिन् mfn. shining, bright, VarBṛS.; Suśr. (said of the outer skin of a snake)
making manifest, Nyāyam.
a: अवभासिन् — a. Shining, bright. --नी The outer skin or cuticle.

v: tri॰ ava + BAsa + Ric--karmmaRi kta । prakASite ।
m: अव-भासित mfn. shining, bright, MBh. xii, 13221
illumined, lighted, MBh. (wrongly written अव-भाषित, vii, 6672), &c.
a: अवभासित — p. p. 1 Illumined, lighted, irradiated. --2 Evident, manifest.

m: अव-भास्य mfn. to be (or being) illumined, Śaṃk.

v: na॰ ava + BAza--lyuw । kaTane “vyApArAntarasaktyanyaTAvaBAzaRavilokanAdikarI” sA॰ da॰ ।
m: अव-भाषण n. speaking against, speaking, Sāh.
अव-भाषित mfn. spoken against, reviled, Kām.
(see अव-√ भास्.)

a: अवभंगः — Humbling, overcoming, defeating; मानावभंगनिपुणं त्वममोघमस्त्रं V. 4. 11.
अवभंज् — {c7c} P. To break off, smash; वनस्पतिं व्रज इवावभज्य Ku. 3. 74; अवभग्नश्च मे मानः Rām., broken down, humbled.

m: अव-भङ्ग m. breaking off (as of the shaft of a bow), Sāh.
hollowing or sinking (of the nose), Suśr.
अव-√ भञ्ज् (ind.p. -भज्ग) to break off, smash, MBh.; Kum. iii, 74.
अव-भञ्जन n. breaking or tearing off, Suśr.
अव-भग्न mfn. broken off, MBh.; R.
broken, injured (as honour), R. iv, 22, 14.
अव-भर्जन n. (√ भृज्), ‘frying’, destroying (as seeds), BhP.
अव-भर्जित mfn. ‘fried’, destroyed (as seeds), BhP.
(√ भृज्, Caus.) roasted, parched, i.e. burned, destroyed, BhP.

v: tri॰ ava + Brasja--kta BarjjAdeSaH । 1 Brazwe 2 dagDe ca ।

m: अव-√ भर्त्स् (p. -भर्त्सयत्) to deter by threatening, MBh. iii, 15096; to deter by scolding, scold, MBh. v, 641 and 7115; R.
अव-भर्त्सन n. scolding, threatening, Jātakam.
अव-भेदक mfn. ‘piercing (the head)’, aching (as hemiplegia) (cf. अर्ध-भेद.)
अव-भेदिन् mfn. splitting, dividing, VS.
a: अवभेदिन् — a. Breaking off, shattering, dividing.

m: अव-√ भृ P. (impf. अवाभरत्, or -भरत्, 2. sg. -भरस्, Ved. Imper. 2. sg. -भरा) to throw or push or press down or into, RV.; to throw or cut off, RV. ii, 20, 6 and x, 171, 2 : Ā. -भरते, to sink down or disappear (as foam), RV. i, 104, 3, to lower, RV. viii, 19, 23 : Pass. (Subj. -भ्रियाते aor. -भारि) to be pressed upon or in (acc.), RV. v, 31, 12; VS. vi, 3 (see अव-√ भा).

m: अव-भृथ m. (once -भृथ, AV. ix, 6, 63) ‘carrying off, removing’, purification or ablution of the sacrificer and sacrificial vessels after a sacrifice, RV. viii, 73, 23, &c.
a supplementary sacrifice (see below) cf. जीवितावभ्˚.
a: अवभृथः — [अव-भृ-क्थन् Uṇ. 2. 3] 1 The end or completion of a principal sacrifice. --2 Bathing at the end of a principal sacrifice for purification; नावभृथं सरस्वत्यां Kāty.; भुवं कोष्णेन कुंडोध्नी मेध्येनावभृथादपि R. 1. 84; प्रीत्याश्वमेधावभृथार्द्रमूर्तेः 6.; 9. 22; 11. 31; 13. 61; Y. 3. 244; Ms. 11. 83. --3 Purification by bathing of the sacrificer and the sacrificial vessels at the end of a sacrifice. --4 The water of purification. --5 A supplementary sacrifice to atone for defects in a principal and preceding one; a sacrifice in general; स्नातवत्यवभृथे ततस्त्वयि Śi. 14. 10. --Comp. --स्नानं ablution after a sacrificial ceremony.

k.v: सान्नाय्यं हविरग्नौ तु हुतं त्रिषु वषट्कृतम्. दीक्षान्तोऽवभृथो यज्ञे तत्कर्मार्हं तु यज्ञियम्.।

m: अव-भृथ—सामन् n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
अव-भृथ—स्नान n. id.
अव-भृथ—स्नपन n. bathing or ablution after a sacrificial ceremony, BhP.
अव-भृथ—यजूंषि n. pl. the Yajus-formulas used for the Ava-bhṛtha, TS.
अवभृथेष्टि f. a supplementary sacrifice to atone for defects in a principal and preceding one, Lāṭy.; KātyŚr.
अव-भृति f. N. of a town (residence of the Āvabhṛtya kings) Comm. on BhP.
अव-√ भिद् (impf. 2. sg. -भिनत्, or -अभिनत् or -अभिनत्; 3. sg. -अभिनत्; aor. 3. sg. -भेत्) to split, pierce, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.
a: अवभिद् — {c7c} P. To break off, shatter.

m: अव-भिन्न mfn. pierced, MBh. vi, 1774
broken, injured, ŚBr.
अव-भ्र See अन्-अवभ्र-राधस्.

m: अव-भुग्न mfn. bent down, MBh. i, 5891.

m: अव-√ भुज् to incurve, Kauś.
a: अवभुज् — {c6c} P. To bend down, curve.
